stem: Voltmarkt's soundbar ASP rose from €210 to €230 after a list price increase. Which conclusion can you draw from ASP alone?

options.text: Net revenue per soundbar unit sold rose by €20 on average
Every soundbar model now sells for exactly €20 more than before
The gross margin on each soundbar unit rose by €20 on average
Voltmarkt's soundbars are now dearer than the two rivals' soundbars
